description: A DJ's public profile: how they play, worked out from their sets (or, until they declare some, the history lists their players recorded), their tracks' analysis and their player settings.

main.description: One per account. Only the sections the DJ chose are present. Never holds file paths, drive or history-list names, ratings or exact dates. Shares are whole percents (0 to 100) and tempos whole BPM.

precision.description: rounded: counts are round numbers the true count is at least, and shares are to 5%. exact: as counted.

basis.description: plays: tracks as played in sets (a track in three sets counts three times). sessions: no sets declared yet, so the history lists players recorded (which can include practice) stand in; the sets section is then absent. collection: no sets were found, so the collection, each track once.

headline.description: One line, written by the DJ or built from the sections present (genres, tempo, how many sets).

tags.description: Traits the numbers support, like "Mixes in key". Only traits backed by a section that's present.

genres.description: The genres played most, with their share of plays.

labels.description: The labels played most, with their share of plays.

artists.description: The artists played most, with their share of plays. A track credited to several artists counts for each.

signature.description: Tracks played again and again, pinned ones first.

sets.description: The sets the profile is built from: how many, since when, and how long.

since.description: The year of the oldest set.

tempo.description: BPM: the range the middle 80% of plays fall in, and the median.

arc.description: Set shape: the percent of sets (sessions when basis is sessions) whose last quarter is at least 2 BPM faster than their first (builds), within 2 BPM of it (steady), or at least 2 BPM slower (windsDown).

shape.description: What half the sets or more do, or varies.

mixing.description: Transitions between consecutive tracks in sets (sessions when basis is sessions), as percents.

harmonic.description: Into a key that mixes on the Camelot wheel (same key, one step, relative, energy boost).

top.description: Camelot keys played most, most first.

minor.description: Percent of plays in minor keys.

topKey.description: One of the keys played most.

energy.description: Percent of plays in each phrase mood (high, mid, low), as the tracks' phrase analysis has it.

medianYear.description: Half the plays came out this year or earlier.

recent.description: Percent of plays released that year or the year before.

prep.description: Percent of the collection with hot cues, memory cues and loops set.

style.description: Player settings that say something about how the DJ plays. Values as in computer.localnetwork.locallibrary.settings.
